tests.hierarchy: 6 passed: attachment continuity/taper/seeds/grounding for four species, explicit upright continuation, and nonzero substrate
tests.fullSuite: 189 passed, 8 failed; full run exposed existing catalog-count, generic-preset/mapping assumptions, and scene-placement assertion allocation failure. Full log copied separately.
fullSuiteFailures: Two tests still require 400 catalog entries (actual 402).
Four generic-tree tests assume foliage/branch complexity incompatible with existing specialized/preserved presets.
One mapping test expects old fallback behavior.
One scene-placement independence assertion raises Array buffer allocation failed while comparing mismatched existing stand assignments.

bugsCorrected: Child paths now attach to rendered parent centerlines and radius, rather than an unrelated cylinder or off-polyline curve sample.
Adjacent rings share tangent frames; interpolated frames repair sub-ring tearing.
Multi-leader joins taper to outgoing leader radii; terminal shoots taper to fine points.
Roots sample valid lower woody zones and reach an exact substrate plane using quadratic arches.
Cacao leader terminates at jorquette unless explicit coherent upright continuation is enabled.
limitations: Branch junctions use overlapping connected tubes, not a watertight boolean-union mesh.
Branches and roots remain low polygon; very close views can reveal faceting.
Substrate is a configurable local plane, not terrain or tidal simulation.
Tertiary twigs can be subpixel in normal-distance screenshots.
No physical Android GPU/frame-time benchmark was performed.

profileChanges.red-mangrove: Broad root spread, multi-height lower-wood attachment, lower persistence and modest phototropism.
profileChanges.stilt-mangrove: Narrower crown/root footprint, upright leader, denser stilt network and stronger persistence/phototropism. Artistic proportions, not a universal rule.
profileChanges.cacao: Jorquette at 0.29 of design height; no upright continuation by default.
profileChanges.rubber: Higher crown split (0.52 of design height), varied secondary systems and stronger inherited upward growth.

performanceSummary.method: Static detailed geometry counts at seed 29; no physical-device/GPU frame-time measurement. More skeleton metadata and paths; adaptive ring sides reduce triangle count. Ring frames cached per segment during mesh build.
